name: Glowtail
description: A little gecko dipped in neon dusk. Its tail-tip glows brighter near secrets, which makes hide-and-seek complicated and night markets irresistible. Glowtail practices slow, wobbly glow-letters in the air when it thinks no one is watching — and so far, every message has been somebody's name.
babyDescription: A dim little squiggle that flickers when it sneezes.
teenDescription: Practices glow-letters on the ceiling after bedtime.
adultDescription: A neon calligrapher with a tail full of names.

history.change: dex-edit: baseColor #1DE9B6 -> #01F1B1, clearing glitchfin at dE00 8.3. W64-ROSTER wants dE00 >= 10 between any two species and only ever measured the fourteen COMPILED ones, so no pack species had been checked against anything since the registry began (B343). Measured across the whole 32-species roster; this is the smallest move that clears 11 against all 31 others. Four pack species were moved rather than eight, because every colliding pair has a pack species in it and the compiled roster needs no change at all.
